title: Kiritani Haruka — You Give Me Wings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
98, 99, 100...!
Okay, that's one set.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm starting to get the hang of doing these exercises while wearing weights.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I guess that means my training is going well.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We have just three days left until Shinobi Battle. I need to keep this up, and get in the best shape I can.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Phew...
Three sets. That should be enough.
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds like you've reached a good place to stop, too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why don't we take this opportunity to rest and rehydrate, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you. I think I will.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Is something the matter?
You giggled after looking at us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
We're taking a break, but you two are still wearing your weighted vests.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, we totally forgot about these...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I remember desperately gasping for air and throwing it off after completing every single set during our first day of training!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That means your hard work is paying off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Actually, I've been wondering...
Where did you get these vests, and all that other strength-training equipment?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A yoga mat is one thing, but I doubt many people have weighted vests like these.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've become so used to a certain director using explosives and odd drones during our performances that I never thought to ask.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And now you're desensitized to these kinds of things...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, the story behind those vests involves...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, Airi, does the show “Battle of the Muscly Stars” ring any bells for you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, of course it does!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The producer for the Wide World of Laughs worked on it, so I got to appear on it as Happy Everyday.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You battled against some female athletes, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you happen to remember the name of the company that made all the props and equipment?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The company that made the props? Yeah, I remember...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, don't tell me. You want to use them to train for Shinobi Battle.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Ideally, yes...
Do you think it'd be possible for me to borrow them?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If I recall, they don't accept personal orders, but they do rent out to individuals.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You should be able to send in a request through their website. Also, you'll be able to save on shipping by going over to their warehouse yourself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks, Airi!
I'll look into it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, the vests and other equipment we've been using were used on Battle of the Muscly Stars?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not necessarily everything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, a company that makes props for TV. They must have an assortment of fun things available for rental.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, they do have quite a large selection.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A giant frying pan that can make yakisoba for a hundred people, a shrine gate, a footbath...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A shrine gate and a footbath?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They even had a skating rink and a merry-go-round.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A skating rink and a merry-go-round?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What shows did they make those for, and why...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't say, since I only had a few minutes to see what they had in their warehouse...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, their rental fees are based on the size of each object, so you can rent out the ones that don't require construction at a very reasonable price.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see. This is a useful bit of information.
I'll have to tell Rui about this later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? He's the last person you should be telling.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you going to do when he ends up building a jet-flow bathtub or a skating rink that produces lightning?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
H-Hahaha. Don't be ridiculous, Akito.
He only makes props for shows, remember?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What kind of show involves using jet-flow bathtubs and skating rinks that produce lightning?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your face is getting all twisted.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, our break's already over.
Are you two ready to continue?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, yes!
I'm ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've gotten pretty used to my training schedule now, so I still feel pretty fresh.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We have three days left.
Let's keep doing our best so that we can post a result we can feel proud of!

rows.Speaker: Akito & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!
